headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch ran for 148 yards and a pair of first-half touchdowns as the Seattle Seahawks beat the Philadelphia Eagles 31-14 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lynch guides Seahawks past error-prone Eagles
